Press the button. We need more. Good job.
We must be quiet returning in case he is here. Let us head back.
Stay here. If I do not return, leave. Be ready to press the email button if anything appears.
Thank you. I will return shortly.
I cannot get these. My character began speaking.
It is okay; we should still return.
Get possessed? No. We have one HP, but pressing the button makes our character automatically say we were abandoned.
Darn it. We need another thousand for the five. We will get there, but I will buy health.
I only have one. The buck is here. We can split. I have twenty-six, so am fairly healthy. We will get a fifty and manage with this.

My name should be uh good to go.
My name should be ready to go.
Transfer HP? Too late; it is okay. Did I do well pressing the button? Yes, you did.
Maybe there's there happened then. She was in my face, so that happened.
She was in my face. Who has low health? Put this in your inventory. I have one HP. Take the fifty-pack. Let us go.

I'll try not to break things.
I will try not to break things.
Finding extraction two first might help. Should we explore far first? Can we do that, or must we finish the first one?
Careful, that attacks. Put it there; it looks valuable. Apparently we must do them in order, according to—
It was valuable. We will do our best. The nose.

You have to do it first.
Is touching the rest of the clown safe? You have another player. What? You must do it first.
Look out; you will be frightened again, Boo.
No. Anything else? Why? Snugglepuff. Why so serious, Snugglepuff?
Why so alien? Careful; I do not know its effect. What does the alien do?
Mepors fancy. What? Of nothing.
Shiori, I need help with a large statue. Let us get the TV first.
Lift teammates before slamming them down? They are shouting; I do not know why. I also—
What happened? Alien. Apparently it lifts you into levitation, and you must wait until it stops.

I kind of need to go there though.
We have eleven thousand and need more. Careful. I need to go there, though.
That place, sir. Hide underneath here. Closer; crawl. Come on.
I will try returning there. We need to.
The statue is troublesome and heavy. Let us find cheaper things while waiting for the monster to leave. I do not trust it to leave us alone.
Excuse me. Go left. Let us find items; hopefully the monster leaves before we return.
What? Whatever. Thank you; I cannot see.
Sorry. How much is that? Fifteen thousand. I left something there; let us return.
That is like one hallway.
Are these everyone's heads? I do not know.
Bring a small item; I think we will be fine.
Help me. Take the head while I take the base. From the head.
We will try. We only need a thousand.
This is the worst statue. This way; I do not know where to go.
Good job. I hope we have everyone's head.
I will search for an item.
Help me lift it. Bounce it. It already got me. I do not know what to do about an alien.
Run. I think we must keep away from it. I need to run and find an item.

It's kind of intense to be honest.
It is rather intense.

I don't see any more items.
I cannot see more items.
I will end myself. I will end myself now.
I will end myself. Why is finding something small so difficult?
What is wrong? Be careful. It is okay; find another item. There is one here.
Run. Is he there? Closer. That was tense.
Now we need the second point and hopefully enough money.
Welcome back. Be careful returning. I saw that but could not reach it. It is okay.
Another extraction point. Why am I dangerous around here?
Go straight right. Is everyone here? Run. Actually, it is fine; run. That creature is okay but may eventually kill me.
Push the cart; I will scout ahead.
I will put the cart down. Thank you, Shiori, for guiding us. No problem.
An item is here, but I might destroy it lifting it. The doll attacks you, but can go in the cart. I should look away.
The extraction point is here. I will leave two items here. That was tense, especially after happening three times. There you go.
Is the cart the blue thing? Yes.
She is dead. Come here; I found something valuable and need help. What is it?
A large box. I will bring the cart. We need twenty-four thousand; it will be okay.
We know the extraction point. I hope there are enough items.
This is worth twenty-four thousand.
Will it fit on the box? We may need to carry it separately. Perhaps it fits on the cart.

If we get twenty-four thousand, go to extraction.
I think I am doomed.
They are there. What is that? An alien puts you in a gravitational pull. If distant on the other side—yes, it blocks. Alien.
The luggage is too—our hands are too much. I do not know.
Can you escape with the box like that? You are going the right way, but I think it may break.
I am stuck.

She is on it. Can she lift it alone? She could crawl beneath it. I think it is sensor. I saw a monster inside; perhaps that is why. She is somewhat safe. I see things in it. A monster box. Alien. I am dead.
Welcome to Limbo.
That was decent. Good job; I think we reached level three or four.
It is okay; you practiced.
I was happy. Dinosaur. My dinosaur.
Demon. There it is. It destroyed it; I did not mean to. What is that? I do not know, but it is dead now.
A computer. I will use the bra. No, rather useless.
Good job. Be of the losers. You are a winner in our hearts.

What did you think of the game?
That was your first R.E.P.O. experience. What did you think?
I want to play more; it is fun.
I am glad. It differs from Lethal Company and is spooky because of cramped spaces. You did well. Play when the style returns.
W. You problem enough, problem enough.
Anything to promote while you spam?
Please look. It is a little different. It might be the prize; please look.
I think Advent has something special appearing tomorrow on the English.
Keep an eye on X tomorrow, unless the plan changes. Watch X tomorrow.
What if nothing happens? It is not our fault.
I am fairly sure something happens. If not, leave it.
Anything else?
Is there a birthday? I have a birthday stream planned on the fourteenth PST, at ten a.m. JST, six p.m. PST.
It is six p.m. PST rather than my usual time because guests will celebrate with me. It will differ a little; I have an explanatory video coming soon.
A video. I look forward to it. Stay a little longer and I will show it. We will birthday.
Explain. Perhaps it is already on my calculator to play.
We should play again, with a full six-player group.
That would mix things up.
I have a Kung Pow: Enter the Fist watchalong tomorrow with Moons and Kronii.

You will keep chatting with your wolf and discuss birthday plans, correct?

Goodbye.

They will discuss birthday plans and, I believe, read superchats.
